questions.subject: MACROECONOMICS
questions.stem: Explain why a larger r-g differential requires a larger primary surplus.

answer.exemplar: A larger gap means debt compounds faster, so a larger primary surplus is needed to offset the automatic increase in the ratio.

questions.explanation: The required surplus scales with the differential because debt grows more quickly when r exceeds g by more.

questions.stem: Explain why high debt with low growth is dangerous.
